event_name: NAPA Auto Parts NHRA Midwest Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 80 degrees, relative humidity 45 percent, barometer 30.13 inches, adjusted
altitude 2,067 feet, track temperature 119 degrees.

Only one TF driver qualified lower than No. 9 has ever made the Final round at this event: Zetterstrom, who
qualified No. 14 in 2025.

The No. 1 TF qualifier has won this race four times in five Final rounds. The last came in 2025.

Shawn Langdon is 8-7 in Final rounds when qualified No. 1, including 3-2 this year.

Langdon is 2 - 0 against Smith in prior events and this is the first time they have faced each other in a
final round.

Smith with the starting line advantage, but Langdon had the lead by the time they go by the Christmas tree and
never trailed for the win.  He wins his fourth consecutive Wally.  This is his eighth win this season and the
30th of his career.

Smith started to lose traction and drop cylinders around half track.
